references.text: The immediate context describing how the Israelites left the Lord and worshiped the Baal gods
Repetition of the same sin: the Israelites forgot the Lord and served the Baals and Asherah poles
The Israelites continued to serve the Baals and Astartes along with other foreign gods
Samuel urges Israel to remove Baal and Astarte and return to the Lord
The Israelites confess that they served the Baals and Astarte goddesses
Solomon worshiped Astarte, the Sidonian goddess, who is also mentioned in Judges 2:13
Elijah confronts Israel about limping between the Lord and Baal
Jeremiah accuses Israel of forsaking the Lord and following Baal
Hosea prophesies judgment against Israel for worshiping the Baals and forgetting the Lord
